decision: Reprimand. 1st Reprimand of the current season (Driving)
event_name: Date 10 November 2018 Time 19:38 2018 BRAZILIAN GRAND PRIX 8 - 11 November 2018 The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, summoned (document 20) and heard the driver and team representative, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Driving unnecessarily slowly on an in lap during Qualifying.
offence: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and failing to observe the Race Director's instruction, document 2 (item 15.1).
penalty: Reprimand. 1st Reprimand of the current season (Driving)
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence, timing, and positioning data and heard from the driver and team representative of Car 35. Car 35 exceeded the specified maximum time between Safety Car Lines on its In lap at 15:18. The Stewards closely examined the drivers In lap and found that Car 35 did not drive in a manner that was unsafe or adversely affected any other driver. While the driver did exceed the delta time on his dash, it appears that the majority of the time was due to a setup error. The Stewards found that the regulation was breached and ordered a reprimand.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations and failing to observe the Race Director's instruction
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 25 2018 Brazilian Grand Prix Offence Car 35 Driving Unnecessarily Slowly
